contentText: Spain's Prime Minister doubled down on his criticism of Washington on March 3rd, a day after Donald Trump threatened to cut off all trade with the country. That itself came in response to Spain's refusal to allow the use of military bases shared with the US in its territory for Washington's continued war with Israel on Iran. Pedro Sanchez warned Trump he was playing Russian roulette with the lives of millions, and urged the world to learn from history.
